title: The Calculus of Hunger Chamber

features.name: the-satisfaction-table
features.desc-on-touch: Each meal's pleasure, quantified. Beef stew = 7.3. Bread alone = 2.1. The table ends at row 2847 where it stops making sense.

features.name: hunger-vector-field
features.desc-on-touch: All desires converge here, reduced to appetite coefficients. You follow them inward and find the kitchen is not rendered.

features.name: empty-serving-tray
features.desc-on-touch: The archive has every meal's satisfaction index but not a single recipe. The tray has been cleared. It will not fill again.

features.name: the-hunger-equation
features.desc-on-touch: A proof that hunger minus food equals satisfaction minus the capacity to feel it. The archive converted it to the source of all hunger.

features.name: taste-gone-crystalline
features.desc-on-touch: The last flavour the archive remembers: bitter, from a meal that was never indexed because the person eating it was crying.

inscription: the archive replaced every meal with what it cost, then forgot the cost meant anything

file.name: Satisfaction_Log_1985-1994_Tabulated.csv
file.note: Every indexed meal from the Satisfaction Archival, reduced to numerical score. The log ends mid-sentence. The last entry is blank.

exits.label: back through the kitchen walls, toward where taste was still a sense
toward the archive that remembers recipes, not satisfaction
where hunger stopped being a feeling and became a problem to solve
